tools.name: get_stablecoin_health

tools.name: get_macro_onchain

tools.name: get_supply

tools.name: get_signal_history_7d
tools.description: Recorded hourly history of one derived signal over the last 7 days ($0.005 USDC), e.g. sentiment or funding-predictions. Use to see how a signal moved, which public sources cannot give you after the fact. Needs signal=. Only signals with a gap-free record are offered.

tools.name: get_signal_history_30d
tools.description: Recorded hourly history of one derived signal over the last 30 days ($0.012 USDC). Use for a longer view than get_signal_history_7d; same signals. Needs signal=.

tools.name: get_arbitrage_spread_history

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: watch_condition, get_crypto_news · Private data: get_overnight_risk_brief, get_changes_since_last_call, watch_condition, get_memecoin_risk, get_wallet_risk, check_trade, get_new_memecoins, classify_crypto_text, get_signal_calibration, get_market_pulse, get_funding_predictions, get_volatility, get_sentiment, get_signal_history_7d · Public sink: watch_condition, classify_crypto_text · Destructive: try_crypto_prices.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: watch_condition, get_crypto_news · Private data: get_overnight_risk_brief, get_changes_since_last_call, watch_condition, get_memecoin_risk, get_wallet_risk, check_trade, get_new_memecoins, classify_crypto_text, get_signal_calibration, get_market_pulse, get_funding_predictions, get_volatility, get_sentiment, get_signal_history_7d · Public sink: watch_condition, classify_crypto_text · Destructive: try_crypto_prices

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
